subject: SSO assertion redaction + attribute-owner mapping request
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@helioslabs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SSO assertions — redaction & attribute-owner mapping request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for partnering on the Helios SIG/CAIQ follow-up. Our compliance team has one focused ask: we need a small sample set (not full production) of SSO assertion traces and the attribute->application owner mapping for your tenant that Helios will audit for least-privilege alignment. Specifically: 

- 10–20 SAML assertions (redacted where appropriate) showing Subject, NameID, email, groups/roles, and any custom attributes (e.g., "project_id").
- A mapping table that indicates who the owner / approver is for each privileged role referenced in the assertion (owner name + contact).
- A short note on retention windows for assertion logs (how long unredacted logs are kept, where).
- Any SCIM delta exports showing user->role changes over the last 30 days would be helpful (if available).

We are sensitive to PII — our preference is that you provide a small, redacted sample via secure link. If redaction guidance is easier for you, send the raw sample and we'll coordinate a secure redaction step on our side under NDA. Deadline for our audit window is 2025-07-25, so a delivery by EOD 2025-07-22 would be ideal.

Quick questions: do your assertion logs include IP or device identifiers that will need special handling? Also — are there any owner/approver fields that live only in your internal admin console (not in assertions)?

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Security Lead — Helios Labs
[aisha.khan@helioslabs.com]

[attachment: compliance_request_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SSO assertions — redaction & attribute-owner mapping request

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide a scoped deliverable that meets your audit needs while minimizing PII exposure. Plan below: 

1) We'll produce 15 sample SAML assertions (production-originated) with the following approach:
   - Remove: IP addresses, device ids, session ids.
   - Hash: NameID and email using SHA256 with a stable salt (we'll provide mapping separately to Helios under a second secure channel if required).
   - Keep (plaintext): group/role and custom attributes required for your role-mapping review.

2) Marcus will pull the assertion bundle and generate a sample CSV for quick triage. Laura will confirm retention/where logs are stored (audit S3 bucket path + retention policy). Soojin will share the SCIM delta list for the last 30 days.

3) Delivery options: secure ShareFile link OR SFTP + one-time password; tell us which you prefer.

Next steps: Marcus — can you pull a 15-assertion sample (date range: 2025-06-01 to 2025-07-01) and run the redaction transform locally so we can preview before delivering? Laura — can you confirm the retention window and data location? Aisha — we can target sending an initial set by 2025-07-18 and the full scoped package by 2025-07-22.

Priya Natarajan
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SSO assertions — redaction & attribute-owner mapping request

Priya — on it. Quick notes from my pull: 

- I exported a 15-assertion sample from the assertion archive (range 2025-06-03 to 2025-06-27). Raw file: saml_assertion_extracts_202506.zip (contains .xml per assertion).
- Fields present that are PII: <NameID>, <SubjectConfirmationData Address="..."> (IP), and an internal "device_id" attribute we set for MFA heuristics.
- Proposed transform (attached): redaction_transform.py — will: strip SubjectConfirmationData/@Address, replace <NameID> and email attributes with stable SHA256(salt||value), and leave Role/Group attributes untouched.

I ran the transform on the sample and attached sso_assertion_sample.csv (columns: assertion_id, nameid_hash, role_list, custom_attrs). The mapping table for owners is partially in our admin console; I can export a CSV mapping role -> owner_name -> owner_email by EOD tomorrow.

Attachment stubs: [saml_assertion_extracts_202506.zip], [sso_assertion_sample.csv], [redaction_transform.py]

- Marcus
